Callout.Name: Shot Spotter Activation
Callout.Message: Gunshot detection system has picked up shots.
Callout.Advisory: No caller, no victim reported, exact address given.

Script.Line: That is the second time tonight on that corner.
The system does not make it up. It picks up the crack.
I have got the log on screen. Four rounds, two shooters.

Lines.Approach: The system heard it and nobody has called it in. Go and have a look.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
